status: development thresholds; recovery and held-out trials blocked until nominal gate

rationale.duration: 13 seconds permits up to two seconds of measured-contact landing transition beyond the original 11-second development budget. Physical thresholds are unchanged; completion time and timeout remain reported.
rationale.lift: 35 mm clearance exceeds five tray half-thicknesses and requires sustained support separation; commanded lift is 60 mm.
rationale.step: At least 75 mm of the 100 mm command and 25 mm swing clearance excludes shuffling without a step.
rationale.balance: 15 degree torso tilt and 25 mm stance drift are provisional margins for a slow nominal task, not physical safety limits.
rationale.setdown: Released tray must remain supported and nearly stationary for 600 ms; a transient touch is insufficient.
rationale.gate: All eight development configurations must pass before recovery comparisons. Eight runs establish a prerequisite, not population reliability.
